description: This file contains unit tests for the KeyValueType and TextKeyValueType classes, testing their constructors, assignment operators, comparisons, and key/value access methods.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A templated class representing a key-value pair with comparison and accessor methods.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, used as a key or value in key-value structures.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A templated class combining text fragments with case sensitivity options, acting as key-value pairs.

methods.name: KeyValueType::KeyValueType
methods.description: Constructs a key-value pair, optionally with key and value.

methods.name: KeyValueType::operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for key-value pairs.

methods.name: KeyValueType::operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for key-value pairs.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Key
methods.description: Returns the key part of the key-value pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Value
methods.description: Returns the value part of the key-value pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::IsKey
methods.description: Checks if the given string matches the key.

methods.name: TextFragment::operator=
methods.description: Assigns a string to a TextFragment.
